name: xstate-analyzer
description: Static analyzer for React / XState / Next.js and Java / Spring Boot projects: call graphs (with Spring DI), XState diagrams, external calls, and multi-project API seams via OpenAPI.

scripts.analyze:demo: tsx src/cli.ts analyze examples/demo -o examples/demo-out --format json,html,mermaid,dot,md
scripts.test:render: node scripts/render-check.mjs examples/demo-out/report.html && node scripts/render-check.mjs examples/workspace-out/report.html
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run analyze:demo -- -q && npm run analyze:workspace -- -q && npm run test:render
scripts.analyze:workspace: tsx src/cli.ts analyze examples -o examples/workspace-out --format json,html,md
